town.name: Replace with town or community name
town.geographyVersion: ASGS or locally governed boundary version
contextLimitations: Area statistics provide context only and do not identify an individual or establish demand.

contextIndicators.label: Resident population
contextIndicators.limitation: Replace with an exact release and geography; this is context, not a demand estimate.

contextIndicators.label: Local housing context
contextIndicators.limitation: Do not infer an individual's housing need from an area measure.

contextIndicators.label: Local workforce or occupation context
contextIndicators.limitation: Employment measures do not show a local opportunity or a contributor's availability.

contextIndicators.label: Local cultural activity or host context
contextIndicators.limitation: A locally governed method and consent are required; do not infer cultural demand from population size.

innovationInfrastructure.assessment: Document what already exists, what is accessible, what is missing, and who governs each resource. National business statistics are context only.

digitalEconomy.localProviderInventory: Map only providers who consent to inclusion, their categories, discovery paths, booking/ordering capabilities, accessibility and update process.

interoperability.specification: Solid/CSS profile version to be recorded
interoperability.implementationProfile: Databox program and IPMS module profile to be recorded
interoperability.conformanceEvidence: implementation test and independent external interoperability result to be recorded

digitalEconomy.assessment: Measure available local systems, external-platform fees/terms where voluntarily supplied, discovery gaps, accessibility and operational support. Do not assume any platform is present or that replacement produces a saving.

energyResilience.assessment: Inventory consented sites, their existing supply arrangements, measured interval demand, critical loads, local generation/storage, network constraints, hazards and service roles. Do not infer energy needs or emergency capacity from building type.

housingSystem.assessment: Keep each published measure, geography, period, programme definition and limitation separate. Do not subtract them into a single shortfall.

opportunity.title: Example: locally programmed music night at a consenting venue
opportunity.host: Named host only after it has consented to publication
opportunity.needStatement: A locally authored statement of the opportunity, benefit sought and constraints.
opportunity.contribution: A defined, voluntary and time-bounded activity. Do not state or infer a contributor's private circumstances.

economic: Record only measured incremental revenue, costs and local supplier payments; do not apply a multiplier without a reviewed method.
socialCultural: Define participant, host and community outcomes with local people before the activity.
capability: Define skills, continuity, local connection or future activity outcomes without promising them in advance.

innovation.communityLeadOrganisation: Replace with the existing community group, cooperative, business, school, service or other local entity that leads the work.
innovation.localProblemStatement: A locally authored problem or opportunity that RD&D will investigate.
infrastructureNeeds: Specify the infrastructure resources requested and their limits.
innovation.benefitSharingTerms: Define ownership, maintenance, access, local benefit and how visitors are recognised or paid.
innovation.dataAndIpGovernance: Define consent, access, retention, publication, IP and culturally appropriate governance before work starts.

digitalEconomy.communityLeadOrganisation: Replace with the local entity accountable for the service.
digitalEconomy.localNeedStatement: A locally authored retail, service, tourism discovery, booking, inventory or credential problem statement.

solidCompatibility.implementationProfile: record Databox program and IPMS module profile
solidCompatibility.conformanceEvidence: record implementation test and independent external result

digitalEconomy.credentialPolicy: If a locals discount credential is proposed, define eligibility, issuer, verifier, minimum data, consent, offline/accessibility alternative, complaints, retention and appeals.

energyResilience.communityLeadOrganisation: Replace with the local entity accountable for the programme.
energyResilience.microgridScope: State whether this is site-only resilience, multi-site coordination, an embedded network, or another jurisdiction-approved arrangement.
energyResilience.meteringBilling: Record the proposed meter, data, retailer/exempt-seller/market, tariff, billing, dispute and exit arrangement after qualified review.

resilienceHub.recoverySupport: Define what can safely be offered during response and recovery, who coordinates it and when specialist accommodation, health or emergency services take precedence.

systemMeasures.limitation: Replace with a release-specific local measure; a dwelling count is not a count of available places or unmet need.

caseCostRecords.limitation: Define cohort, included resources and comparability; do not use this as a universal individual cost.

highNeedPathways: High-support housing and specialist pathways may be needed for people with complex health/substance-use support, palliative or hospital discharge needs, aged-care/disability support, staffed youth accommodation or justice transition. Determine fit through responsible specialist services.
housingPathways.earlyIntervention: Define a voluntary pathway for people whose independently assessed needs can be safely met through community grounds plus agreed supports. The intended reduction in demand is a hypothesis to test, not an eligibility filter or a housing-allocation rule.
housingPathways.siteSafety: Plan prevention, clear expectations, resident voice, trained support, restorative/complaints pathways, incident records and immediate emergency escalation. Do not treat fewer police call-outs as success if people cannot report harm or seek help.
